correctness.rationale: Exact two-state transfer expression follows from decomposition by chord use and seam; mod-two third-order transfer gives parity; determinant ±1 and b,c even prove no zeros for n odd divisible by three, and rule out h=+ zeros when n divisible by six. The eight length-six blocks and six base witnesses supply all residue classes, all-length zeros, exact sharp gaps and a constructive exponential zero-family. Standalone independent perfect-matching enumeration and full signed Walsh transforms verified each reduced character for 3<=n<=12 (16,664 exact assertions), including 36 and 1,392 reduced zeros for n=6,12. Finite checks corroborate the infinite proof.
